done_when: forge read records a round as passed when its only other line is a tests-not-run note followed by any trailing clause after a semicolon, comma or dash (for example 'Tests were not run; runtime behaviour remains unverified.'); a real finding still fails; the existing no-findings command test gains that case for a new repo and one adopted on an earlier release
why: A clean cold read still fails when its tests-not-run note carries a trailing clause, such as 'Tests were not run; runtime behaviour remains unverified.'
